head: a15f24ad44fc22f86e1e1fd9f2ae47b6bb0ba860
status: Resolved implementation choices from static source, not implementation or acceptance. No P06 source changed.

source_evidence: glam-0.32.1/src/f32/vec2.rs:430-432: is_finite is exactly component-wise f32::is_finite conjunction
const_point_admission.change: Make the existing checked from_metres leaf const by using the identical component-wise checks and an explicit if/Some/None instead of non-const Vec2::is_finite/then_some. Do not add an unchecked or panic-at-runtime point constructor.
const_point_admission.authored_boundary: Adapt the existing capture v! macro with a literal boundary-view form that performs checked ScenePlanPoint admission inside a const block, then stores the checked point in CapturePose. Invalid authored coordinates must fail compile-time evaluation. Replace the ten old raw x/z entries; do not retain a legacy variant or create a new fixture helper. Existing full pose-expression macro use remains for other authored poses.
const_point_admission.style: When editing the canonical point file, apply imports/reexports before module declarations and keep its existing test modules after all production impls.

source_evidence: presentation/terrain.rs:40-88 currently substitutes minimum height and writes alpha=255
heightmap_absence_contract.decision: Build the image and checked elevation range together. Return a structured absence/admission error if the physical range is unavailable or any required encoded sample has no support. Never turn a missing hit into the minimum, and do not claim that writing unused alpha fixes the consumers. Preserve the complete image bytes/interpolation/quantization for supported inputs; no shader schema change is needed for a fully admitted image.
heightmap_absence_contract.owner: Extract heightmap encoding from the oversized terrain presentation root into its own owning module. A named image-plus-range record avoids positional tuple erasure and incoherent retained bindings. The named range retains canonical SupportElevation endpoints.
heightmap_absence_contract.consumer_policy: Optional weather/tree presentation may remain unavailable on this error, without publishing a new-scene material or reusing another scene image as current. Required viewer setup/capture propagates the typed rejection. Admit the new image/range before mutating retained tree cache state; weather already clears the old scene before admission.
heightmap_absence_contract.migration_risk: Previously unsupported raster positions were silently imputed. Scenes with incomplete physical support now expose that absence. Existing sampled/owned fixtures and hosted presentation selections must establish supported-path preservation; missing-scene and calibrated renderer scenarios are not newly covered by unauthorized tests.

clamped_landform_queries.source_evidence: scene/admission.rs:55-62 validates finite positive scale and finite represented extents; therefore native rectangular clamp bounds are finite.
clamped_landform_queries.decision: Both terrain landform helpers currently implement the same bounded rectangular clamp then expect a hit. Reuse one explicit typed clamped-query owner and propagate missing support through TerrainRecipeResult. Preserve the exact old clamp calculation and keep arbitrary source points distinct from admitted scene-plan points. Do not add zero/NaN/infinity substitutions.
clamped_landform_queries.pending_detail: Choose the smallest coherent shared query API during implementation; both density families and fallible marching callbacks must migrate together.
